 Al-Kholood are tightening their defensive pressure. Forward Julien Domingues arrives late to a challenge against Iñigo Martínez, conceding an attacking foul. The visiting side is pushing for a second goal to extend their lead.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 53' 3:17 PM ET 11 minutes ago Substitution for Al-Kholood.
 Substitution for Al-Kholood. Shaquille Riley Pinas leaves the pitch and is replaced by Abdulrahman Al Obaid for the visiting side. This is Al-Kholood's first substitution, following Pinas experiencing pain while on the pitch at Al-Nassr's stadium.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 49' 3:15 PM ET 13 minutes ago Al-Nassr are applying pressure once again.
 Al-Nassr are applying pressure once again. Sadio Mané sends a cross into the box, where João Félix connects with a left-footed shot from close range but misses the target. The home side’s attack is pushing to extend their lead and get back in front on the scoreboard.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 46' 3:11 PM ET 18 minutes ago Yellow card for Al-Nassr.
 Yellow card for Al-Nassr. João Félix is ​​late into a challenge on John Buckley and is cautioned by the referee. The forward is now on a booking, putting him at risk of being sent off in this international match.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 3:08 PM ET 20 minutes ago 2º/45' - Second half begins
 The ball is rolling once again at Alawwal Park. In a match that has already seen four goals, Al-Nassr and Al-Kholood are currently level at 2-2, as part of the 12th round of the Saudi Pro League. Follow our real-time coverage of the second half.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 48' 2:50 PM ET 39 minutes ago End of the first half
 The first half comes to an end at Alawwal Park. In a match featuring four goals, Al-Nassr and Al-Kholood are currently level at 2-2, in this fixture for the 12th round of the Saudi Pro League. We will be back shortly to cover the second half of the encounter.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 46' 2:48 PM ET 41 minutes ago Goal for Al-Kholood!
 Antoin Essomba equalizes! The forward enters the penalty area from the right side, strikes the ball with his right foot, and finds the back of the net, beating goalkeeper Bento. Al-Kholood levels the score once again before the end of the first half.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 43' 2:44 PM ET an hour ago Al-Kholood are under pressure and trying to protect their
 Al-Kholood are under pressure and trying to protect their own penalty area. Ângelo attempts to move into the box, but Abdulrahman Al Dosari arrives late to the challenge and commits a foul as the first half nears its end. Al-Nassr remain in the lead.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 38' 2:39 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Al-Nassr!
 Sadio Mané turns the match around for the home side. On a counter-attack, the forward receives the ball and enters the penalty area. The left-winger fires a cross-goal shot with his right foot, finding the back of the net and extending Al-Nassr's lead in the match.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 33' 2:35 PM ET an hour ago Al-Nassr is thwarted.
 Al-Nassr is thwarted. From a corner kick, Ângelo sends the ball into the box, finding Mohamed Simakan. The center-back rises to head the ball from the middle, but it deflects off the Al-Kholood defense. Al-Nassr looks to extend their lead.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 28' 2:31 PM ET an hour ago Almost a SECOND GOAL for Al-Kholood.
 Almost a SECOND GOAL for Al-Kholood. Shaquille Pinas tries a left-footed shot from outside the box, but goalkeeper Bento parries it away, denying the visitors another goal. Al-Kholood is applying pressure once again, searching for their second goal of the match.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 24' 2:27 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Al-Nassr!
 Ângelo equalizes at Alawwal Park. João Félix sets up the play and finds the forward inside the box; the goalscorer fires a left-footed cross-shot from the middle of the area, hitting the back of the net and bringing the match level.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 20' 2:21 PM ET an hour ago Yellow card for Al-Nassr.
 Yellow card for Al-Nassr. Ângelo is late into a challenge on John Buckley and is cautioned by the match officials. The forward is now on a booking and at risk of being sent off. Al-Kholood maintains their lead.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 17' 2:17 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Al-Kholood!
 Julien Domingues opens the scoring for the visitors. Abdulrahman Al Dosari provides the assist for the goalscorer, who steps into the box and fires a cross-goal shot with his right foot, finding the back of the net past goalkeeper Bento. Al-Kholood take the lead.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 12' 2:14 PM ET an hour ago Al-Nassr goal DISALLOWED.
 Al-Nassr goal Disallowed. The video assistant referee (VAR) spots an offside position in the build-up, leading to the hosts' goal being ruled out. Cristiano Ronaldo had opened the scoring for the home side, but the match returns to a goalless state.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 09' 2:12 PM ET an hour ago Goal for Al-Nassr!
 Cristiano Ronaldo opens the scoring. Abdullah Al Hamddan provides a pass to the forward, who steps into the box. The number 7 fires a cross-shot with his right foot toward the center, finding the back of the net against Al-Kholood. VAR confirms the goal for the hosts.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 07' 2:09 PM ET an hour ago João Félix passes to Ângelo
 João Félix passes to Ângelo, who enters the box on the left side. The striker follows up with a left-footed shot across goal, but goalkeeper Al-Shanqiti makes the save. Al-Nassr maintains the pressure and looks for the opening goal in the match.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 05' 2:08 PM ET an hour ago From a corner kick, Abdullah Al Khaibari controls
 From a corner kick, Abdullah Al Khaibari controls the ball inside the area, attempts a shot with his left foot into the corner, but misses the target. Al-Nassr tries to maintain pressure in the match against Al-Kholood.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 2:02 PM ET an hour ago 1º/00' - The match begins!
 The referee blows the opening whistle at Alawwal Park. The ball is in play for the first half between Al-Nassr and Al-Kholood, as part of the 12th round of the Saudi Pro League. Follow our real-time coverage of this big match.
 Live updates by Lucas Monteiro
 1:57 PM ET 2 hours ago Not long to go!
 In less than five minutes, the ball will start rolling for the match between Al-Nassr and Al-Kholood at Alawwal Park, as part of the 12th round of the Saudi Pro League. The match is about to begin—stay tuned for updates on this international clash.
